card.name: Linking words between lipid-lowering drug names
card.fires_on: Commas, 'and' or 'or' right after a lipid-lowering drug name (lomitapide, ezetimibe, bempedoic acid, cholestyramine) where another such drug is about to be named.

card.plain: It fires on the small joining word or comma that comes after a cholesterol-lowering drug name, just before the next drug is named.
